title: IPR / patent portfolio management
surviving_claim: Dedicated IP/tech-transfer platforms EXIST but are not JOINED TO INCUBATION PROGRAMME MANAGEMENT, and none has Indian data residency. Incu (Sweden) has a patent field but not a workflow.

title: TRL as a first-class, reportable object
surviving_claim: Every platform tracks 'stage' as free text. Nobody models TRL AND maps it to eligible Indian funding schemes.

title: YUKTI-NIR / IIC / ARIIA submission workflow
surviving_claim: Zero of 29 competitors. Highest-value and most-defensible gap in the category.

title: Unified mandate-spanning reporting
surviving_claim: Accubate has multi-site structure but no Indian mandate spans.

title: Government-grant disbursement ledger traced to a receipt
surviving_claim: Everyone has a general ledger; nobody scheme-matches to Indian eligibility.

title: Faculty, Innovation Ambassadors and the non-startup innovator
surviving_claim: Faculty are first-class in TECH-TRANSFER platforms but absent from every INCUBATION platform, which all build from 'startup application'.

title: Mentor logistics at scale - NDA-tiered visibility
surviving_claim: MAARG matches mentors but does not tier visibility by NDA and does not log hours against scheme utilisation. The NDA gap itself survives.

title: AI that is auditable instead of just advertised
surviving_claim: AI is now widespread, but audit trails are the differentiator: VentureLink logs every score change with actor and reason, and EcoSync refuses AI scoring outright.

title: Unincorporated pre-incubation state
surviving_claim: Every platform assumes a registered entity; the university funnel is mostly before incorporation.

title: Guaranteed migration off forms/spreadsheets/WhatsApp
surviving_claim: Still the #1 real blocker in an Indian institutional sale; more vendors claim it than actually do it.

title: Departments and multi-campus sub-tenancy
surviving_claim: Multi-site is becoming table stakes; sub-tenant-per-DEPARTMENT with departmental P&L and SPV-vs-department IP ownership is still absent.

title: Deployment model an Indian university can actually buy
surviving_claim: Still unoccupied. Note Phase 8: Fedena sells a FULL ERP at ₹1,00,000 flat, so the market exists - StartupHub must simply match that shape.

title: A verifiable Indian reference institution
surviving_claim: No competitor demonstrates a LARGE INDIAN UNIVERSITY deployment with named referees and third-party verification. The best evidence in the category is a VENDOR_CLAIM (EcoSync) and a NAMED_REFERENCE at a non-Indian university.
